title: 社会影响与AI群体中科学注意力的分配
summary: 研究将Music Lab实验设计应用于学术注意力市场，让1000个AI智能体从2025年《美国经济评论》114篇论文中选择。社会影响条件下的智能体选择论文数量减少17.2%，选择更集中，集体覆盖73篇论文（独立条件下为90篇）。随机分配初始选择可使后续选择率提高45.55个百分点。
summary_en: This paper adapts the Music Lab design to a market for academic attention, having 1,000 AI agents choose papers from 114 AER 2025 articles. Social-influence communities selected 17.2% fewer papers per agent, concentrated choices more heavily, and covered 73 papers vs. 90 independently. Randomly assigning five initial selections raised subsequent selection rates by 45.55 percentage points.
